description: Where I Stand I’m a conservative grounded in limited but effective government, local control, individual responsibility, and protecting the rights of the people I represent. Government’s job is to do a few essential things - and do them well: Protect rights and uphold the law Maintain the basic systems communities rely on Use taxpayer dollars responsibly
